name: cmux
description: Open source Ghostty-based macOS terminal with vertical tabs and notifications for AI coding agents. Built for multitasking, organization, and programmability.
one_liner: A Mac terminal app built specifically for running several AI coding assistants at once, with clear notifications when one of them needs your attention.
buyer: A developer who routinely runs multiple AI coding agent sessions in parallel and keeps losing track of which one is waiting on them.
business_use_cases: A solo developer juggling five parallel Claude Code sessions uses the notification rings to know instantly which one needs input, instead of babysitting every tab.
A remote dev team standardizes on it for SSH'ing into shared build boxes with AI agents attached, using its built-in browser-import and SSH workspace features.
A dev-tools reviewer/YouTuber builds content and affiliate recommendations around 'best terminal for running AI agents', driving install traffic.

money_ideas.idea: Keep the core app free and sell a team/enterprise tier with shared workspace management and admin controls.

steal_this: If you already run multiple AI agents daily, switch your own workflow to it this week and publish a short 'how I manage 5 parallel Claude Code sessions' post — decent audience-building content, not a huge business on its own.
